data.title: Shura Council Speaker Begins Official Visit to Kyrgyz Republic
data.content:
Riyadh, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Shura Council Speaker Sheikh Dr. Abdullah bin Mohammed bin Ibrahim Al Al-Sheikh has begun an official visit to the Kyrgyz Republic at the head of a Shura Council delegation, following an invitation from the speaker of the Supreme Council of Kyrgyzstan.
    In a press statement, Al Al-Sheikh affirmed that the visit reflects the commitment of Saudi Arabia and the Kyrgyz Republic to strengthening bilateral relations, expanding mutual cooperation, and facilitating the exchange of parliamentary expertise. He noted that parliamentary diplomacy complements official diplomacy in fostering friendship, dialogue, and coordination on issues of common interest.
    During the visit, the speaker will hold talks with his Kyrgyz counterpart to advance bilateral relations and consolidate legislative ties.
    -- SPA
